changelog:
A stream that fails now says what happened, in plain words.

WHAT CHANGED

- Instead of only "could not play that stream", the television now says
  what it observed: the server says the stream is gone, the server
  refused it, the server did not answer, the connection failed, or what
  arrived was not playable.
- A stream this television cannot decode says so in its own words, so a
  format problem is never mistaken for a network problem.
- The television also sends its observation back to the phone, which
  checks the same channel from its side and tells you whether the
  stream is actually alive.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. Pairing, playback and updating are unchanged; only
  the words on a failure are new.
